newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU may give Bulgaria grain aid.
newsitem.headline: EU may give Bulgaria grain aid.

text.p: The European Union will consider providing Bulgaria with about two million Ecus in grain aid to help meet a current shortage, external relations Commissioner Hans van den Broek said on Tuesday.

Van den Broek said the grain could be given under the EU's ECHO humanitarian aid programme. "We can see what short-term needs there can be fulfilled. We are ready to look at that under ECHO," he told a news conference after EU foreign ministers met Bulgarian foreign minister Stoyan Stalev.
"We can think of a couple of million ecus," he said.
Bulgaria is currently experiencing an acute grain shortage after an uncontrolled export drive two years ago depleted supplies.
A poor harvest last year was attributed to bad weather and a lack of funds for fertiliser.
